name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's meticulous nature and unwavering commitment to excellence have made him a cornerstone of Sodi Kart Factory's quality control division. His journey into motorsport began unexpectedly when, as a young engineering student, he volunteered at a local karting event. He was immediately captivated by the intricate mechanics and the relentless pursuit of marginal gains.

Over the years, Park has honed his skills through experience at various levels of motorsport. He approaches his role with a blend of rigorous analysis and practical problem-solving. Park is known for his sharp eye for detail, identifying and addressing potential issues before they escalate. His dedication is not just about meeting standards; it's about exceeding them, ensuring that every kart leaving the factory is built to perform at its absolute best. What sets him apart is his quiet intensity; he doesn't need to shout to command respect; his expertise speaks for itself.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A slender man with a focused gaze and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Insists on using a specific brand of calipers.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
